title: Efficacy of Seated Physical Activity INtervention(SPIN) for Wheelchair Users With Multiple Sclerosis
official: Examining the Efficacy of a Home-Based Exercise Training Intervention for Wheelchair Users With Multiple Sclerosis
summary: The purpose of this study is to assess changes in the outcome of exercise behavior between the SPIN exercise-training condition and the WEllness for Longevity Living (WELL) attention/contact wellness control condition and to examine differences in exercise behavior, functioning, disability, and health between the SPIN and WELL conditions
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of multiple sclerosis (MS).
* Self-reported use of a wheelchair (manual wheelchair, power wheelchair, or scooter) ≥50% of the time.
* Relapse-free for the past 30 days.
* Godin Leisure Time Exercise Questionnaire Health Contribution Score \<14 units (i.e., not meeting current physical activity guidelines).

Exclusion Criteria:

* An MS relapse within the past 30 days
sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center, Houston
